name: Waking Crypts raises Crypt Plague damage by 50% (#4149)
contract: Waking Crypts 570136 (CharacterAdvancement 33750, Death tab) reads "Increases the damage of Crypt Plague by $s1% and Crypt Swarm now deals $s2% more damage for each Necromancer disease you have on the target." Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0x800000, 0) in family 29, which matches only the Crypt Plague debuff 570131 (family flags 0, 0x800000, 0); Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone applies it to periodic damage, so Crypt Plague ticks are calculated at x1.50 while Flesh to Worms 500338 (0x4000, 0, 0x20) keeps x1.00. Effect 1 (BasePoints 3 + 1 = 4) is turned into a dummy by the load contract and implemented in the Necromancer damage-taken hook: Crypt Swarm damage 800343 is multiplied by 1 + 0.04 per distinct Necromancer disease the caster has on the target (AscensionNecromancer::Diseases counts auras, not stacks). Expected: with the talent, Crypt Plague ticks are calculated at x1.50 and Flesh to Worms at x1.00; Crypt Swarm gets no bonus without a disease; unlearning restores x1.00 Crypt Plague damage. The per-disease Crypt Swarm term is not asserted: script_spell_damage_taken needs a player victim and the Crypt Plague helper 570132 cannot target an enemy player (SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS).
